diagram.title: Four different deployment boundaries
diagram.prediction: Which row is tested by the exported object alone?
diagram.reading: Read top to bottom from the raw request to the response. Each row has a distinct contract and a distinct failure. The exported computation handles the numeric call; request fields, artifact identity and response meaning require surrounding checks. The fresh-process experiment exercises loading and calling under the installed CPU runtime.
